name: UrBackup Server
description: Backs up whole Windows, macOS and Linux PCs (image and file backups) to this NAS.
notes: Install the UrBackup client on each PC; it finds this server on the local network automatically.
compose:
services:
  urbackup:
    image: uroni/urbackup-server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./database:/var/urbackup
      - ${SHARE:pcbackup}:/backups
